name: Bar smartphone (slate)
definition: touchscreen smartphone in one rigid slab-shaped body.
notes: Smartphone database lists iPhone 17 Pro and Galaxy S26+; Wikipedia names slate form.

name: Keyboard-bar smartphone
definition: one-piece smartphone with a fixed physical keyboard below the screen (`era` tag).
notes: Wikipedia lists keyboard-bar models (Treo 650, Motorola Q); Unihertz Titan 2 sold with physical keyboard.

name: Flip foldable smartphone
definition: smartphone whose flexible screen folds across its width into a compact square.
notes: Shops split foldables into flip and fold; Galaxy Z Flip and Razr sold as flip.

name: Book foldable smartphone
definition: smartphone whose flexible screen folds along its length and opens like a book into a tablet-sized screen.
notes: Harvey Norman defines fold phones as bi-fold booklet design; Galaxy Z Fold8, Pixel Pro Fold.

name: Bar feature phone
definition: non-smartphone mobile phone in one rigid body with a keypad (taco and other one-piece shapes carry a `form_tag`).
notes: Nokia 3310 3G sold as retro bar-style feature phone; Wikipedia lists taco shapes (N-Gage).

name: Flip feature phone
definition: non-smartphone mobile phone whose body folds on a hinge (clamshell).
notes: Best Buy Canada separates basic flip phones from foldable smartphones; Wikipedia clamshell models.

name: Slider phone
definition: mobile phone whose screen half slides over the keypad half (`era` tag).
notes: Wikipedia form factor article names slider models (Samsung SGH-D500, Nokia N95).

name: Swivel phone
definition: mobile phone whose screen half rotates on a pivot to show the keypad (`era` tag).
notes: Wikipedia form factor article names swivel models (LG U900, Nokia 7370).

name: Satellite phone
definition: handheld phone that places calls through satellites rather than a cellular network.
notes: Shop sells Iridium, Inmarsat and Thuraya satellite phones under that category name.

name: Landline phone
definition: telephone for a fixed line, corded or cordless (DECT); `handset` is an attribute (the corded half is attested at the harvest).
notes: Galaxus Phones category holds corded Gigaset Desk 400 and DECT-era Panasonic KX-TG6761GB; cordless not split.

name: Handheld two-way radio (walkie-talkie)
definition: battery-powered push-to-talk transceiver held in the hand.
notes: Motorola describes MOTOTRBO R7 as a digital portable two-way radio.

name: Vehicle-mounted two-way radio
definition: two-way transceiver made to be installed in a vehicle (provisional until attested).
notes: Motorola sells APX 4500 as a mobile radio for vehicle installations.

name: Base-station transceiver
definition: fixed two-way transceiver run from mains power at one site (provisional until attested).
notes: PSI shop category Radio Base Stations lists Motorola, Kenwood and Midland base stations.

name: Pager
definition: small receiver that alerts its carrier and shows short messages sent over a paging network.
notes: Shop sells Motorola Minitor 6 pagers; Wikipedia describes Minitor receive-only voice pager.

name: Slate tablet
definition: touchscreen computer in one flat body, sold without a keyboard (an optional keyboard cover is a part); size is an attribute.
notes: Coolblue and Smartprix list Galaxy Tab, iPad and Lenovo tablets; keyboard sold separately.

name: E-reader
definition: device sold for reading e-books, usually on an e-paper screen; size class, `panel` and `platform` are attributes.
notes: Galaxus eReaders category lists Kobo models; MobileRead matrix lists e-readers by maker.

name: E-paper writing tablet
definition: e-paper device sold for stylus note-taking and handwriting (provisional until attested).
notes: Slashgear lists e-ink writing tablets (reMarkable 2, Supernote); Kobo Elipsa sold with stylus.

name: Electronic organiser
definition: pocket device that keeps a diary, address book and notes (digital diary).
notes: Science Museum calls Pilot 5000 an electronic organiser; Wikipedia covers Casio and Sharp organisers.

name: PDA or palmtop
definition: handheld personal digital assistant running applications on a small screen with stylus or keyboard.
notes: Science Museum object type PDA holds Newton MessagePad and Psion devices.

name: Electronic dictionary
definition: handheld device holding one or more dictionaries for look-up.
notes: Wafuu sells Casio Ex-word XD-SA4900BU as an electronic dictionary.

name: Pocket translator
definition: handheld device that translates speech or text between languages.
notes: B&H category Handheld Voice Translators lists Pocketalk, Vasco and Timekettle devices.

name: Smartwatch
definition: wrist device with a display that runs apps and notifications; a GPS sports watch is this kind with `multisport_gps`.
notes: AT&T smartwatch shop lists Apple Watch, Galaxy Watch; Garmin catalogue lists GPS smartwatches.

name: Hybrid smartwatch
definition: analogue-hand watch with built-in sensors and phone connection.
notes: Wareable lists hybrid smartwatches: Withings ScanWatch, Garmin Vivomove Sport.

name: Smart band (fitness tracker, activity tracker)
definition: slim wrist band with a small display that tracks activity, sleep and heart rate.
notes: Engadget fitness tracker guide lists Fitbit Charge 6, Garmin vivosmart 5, Xiaomi Smart Band 9.

name: Screenless band
definition: wrist band with sensors and no display, read through a phone app.
notes: TechRadar compares screenless bands Amazfit Helio Strap, Polar Loop, Whoop 5.0 (excerpt shows names only).

name: Smart ring
definition: finger ring with sensors that tracks health and activity.
notes: Android Authority guide lists Oura Ring 4, Galaxy Ring, Amazfit Helio Ring.

name: Smart glasses
definition: glasses with a see-through display, camera or speakers (a headset that encloses the eyes is D5).
notes: Buyer guide lists Ray-Ban Meta, XREAL, Even Realities smart glasses.

name: Handheld hiking GPS
definition: portable satellite-navigation unit with maps made to be carried on foot outdoors.
notes: Garmin page titles eTrex 32x Hiking GPS under Handhelds hiking category.

name: Handheld GPS with two-way radio
definition: handheld GPS unit with a two-way radio in the same case; `radio_service` is recorded.
notes: Garmin Rino 750 and 755t sold as handheld GPS with built-in 5W FRS/GMRS radio.

name: Golf GPS device
definition: handheld or clip-on GPS unit that gives distances on golf courses.
notes: PlayBetter Golf GPS Handhelds category lists Bushnell, Garmin, SkyCaddie, Shot Scope.

name: Portable sat-nav (car navigation unit)
definition: portable navigation unit with road maps, sold to be moved between vehicles (a mounted one is G1).
notes: Garmin DriveSmart 76 is a car GPS navigator; TomTom GO Navigator docks and undocks from magnetic mount.

name: Satellite messenger
definition: handheld device that sends and receives text messages and SOS alerts through satellites.
notes: GPS Central lists inReach, SPOT, ZOLEO two-way satellite messengers.

name: Personal locator beacon
definition: one-way distress beacon that sends a position to rescue services via satellite.
notes: GPS Central describes ACR 406 Link as the personal locator beacon, one-way, no subscription.

name: Bluetooth item tracker
definition: small tag attached to an item and located through a phone's finding network.
notes: Pocket-lint compares Apple AirTag, Tile and Galaxy SmartTag Bluetooth trackers.

name: GPS or cellular tracker
definition: tracker with its own GPS and cellular link (SIM, subscription) carried by a person or put in a bag (`user` tag: child or adult; an animal tracker is B10, a vehicle tracker G1).
notes: Jiobit GPS tracker for kids sold with connection plan; Pocket-lint names SmartThings Tracker LTE.

name: Power bank
definition: portable rechargeable battery that charges phones and other devices; `capacity_wh`, `output_w` and `built_in_cable` are attributes.
notes: Anker lists 20000mAh power banks (Prime, Zolo); Walmart sells onn power banks.

name: Magnetic power bank
definition: power bank that attaches magnetically to the back of a phone and charges it wirelessly (MagSafe, Qi2); stays a kind only if a comparison source ranks it apart (C10(b)).
notes: Anker MagGo Qi2 magnetic power banks listed as their own collection.

name: Phone case
definition: case or cover made to hold and protect one phone model.
notes: Verizon sells OtterBox cases per phone model (Galaxy S25, iPhone 16).

name: Tablet case
definition: case or cover made to hold and protect one tablet model.
notes: LDLC Tablet case category: Samsung Smart Book Cover for Galaxy Tab S9/S9 FE.

name: Screen protector
definition: film or glass sheet cut to cover the screen of one device.
notes: SHI sells ZAGG InvisibleShield Glass Elite screen protector for iPhone 17.

name: Watch strap or band
definition: replacement strap made for one smartwatch or band.
notes: JB Hi-Fi lists Apple Watch Sport Loop band as Apple Watch bands accessory.

name: Device charging dock or puck
definition: dock, stand or puck charger made for one device.
notes: elago W9 charging puck stand fits Apple Watch and Galaxy Watch; HyperJuice puck stand.

name: Stylus
definition: pen made for the screen of one tablet or phone line.
notes: Huskertech sells Apple Pencil 1st, 2nd generation and Pro as iPad accessories.

name: Tablet keyboard cover
definition: cover with a keyboard made for one tablet line.
notes: Huskertech sells Smart Keyboard Folio, Magic Keyboard and Logitech Slim Folio for iPad.

name: E-reader cover
definition: case or cover made to protect one e-reader model.
notes: JB Hi-Fi: Kobo Clara Colour/BW SleepCover, eBook reader accessory case.

name: Phone battery case
definition: phone case with a built-in battery that charges the phone.
notes: Walmart battery-case category lists Mophie Juice Pack and Owyfho cases for iPhone.

name: Clip-on phone lens
definition: add-on lens that clips over a phone camera.
notes: Tom's Guide: Sandmarc iPhone lenses come with a clip to attach to the phone.

name: Phone gimbal
definition: motorised handheld stabiliser made for a phone.
notes: B&H Smartphone Gimbal Stabilizers category lists 94 items (DJI Osmo Mobile, Zhiyun, Hohem).

name: Selfie stick
definition: extendable pole that holds a phone for self-portraits.
notes: B&H sells Ulanzi RMT-01 selfie stick/tripod for smartphones.

name: Clip-on phone game controller
definition: game controller that clips onto a phone.
notes: LDLC sells Razer Kishi V3 Pro controller for smartphone, USB-C; clip-on shape not stated.
